exposure: index of foramen ovale (FO) flap movement
outcome: necessity for urgent neonatal Rashkind procedure
cohort: The study involved one case of a fetus with isolated dextro-transposition of the great arteries.
finding: Analysis of a new index of foramen ovale (FO) flap movement based on fetal atrial M-mode successfully predicted the need for an emergency Rashkind procedure on the first day of postnatal life.
followup_time: First day of postnatal life (for the Rashkind procedure)
